SELECT DISTINCT calculated_metrics.metric 
FROM calculated_metrics 
WHERE calculated_metrics.value IS NOT NULL AND calculated_metrics.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR AND calculated_metrics.tenant_id = %(tenant_id_1)s::INTEGER AND calculated_metrics.tenant_id = %(tenant_id_2)s::INTEGER

WITH RECURSIVE m(metric) AS (
          SELECT * FROM (SELECT metric FROM financial_facts WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant)s ORDER BY metric LIMIT 1)
          UNION ALL
          SELECT (SELECT t2.metric FROM financial_facts t2
                  WHERE t2.tenant_id = %(tenant)s AND t2.metric > m.metric
                  ORDER BY t2.metric LIMIT 1)
          FROM m WHERE m.metric IS NOT NULL
        )
        SELECT metric FROM m WHERE metric IS NOT NULL

WITH RECURSIVE m(metric) AS (
          SELECT * FROM (SELECT metric FROM calculated_metrics
            WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant)s AND status = 'ok' AND value IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY metric LIMIT 1)
          UNION ALL
          SELECT (SELECT t.metric FROM calculated_metrics t
            WHERE t.tenant_id = %(tenant)s AND t.status = 'ok' AND t.value IS NOT NULL
              AND t.metric > m.metric ORDER BY t.metric LIMIT 1)
          FROM m WHERE m.metric IS NOT NULL
        )
        SELECT metric FROM m WHERE metric IS NOT NULL

WITH RECURSIVE m(metric) AS (
          SELECT * FROM (SELECT metric FROM financial_facts WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant)s ORDER BY metric LIMIT 1)
          UNION ALL
          SELECT (SELECT t2.metric FROM financial_facts t2
                  WHERE t2.tenant_id = %(tenant)s AND t2.metric > m.metric
                  ORDER BY t2.metric LIMIT 1)
          FROM m WHERE m.metric IS NOT NULL
        )
        SELECT metric FROM m WHERE metric IS NOT NULL
